name: ai-game-development-pipeline

scripts.validate: node tools/validate-repo.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='registry/ai-game-media-systems.v1.json';const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));const c=m.entries.find(e=>e.entry_id==='voice.chatterbox');c.execution_status='EXECUTED';c.execution_record={path:'experiments/../experiment.json',experiment_id:'..'};const u=m.entries.find(e=>e.entry_id==='asset.unirig');u.execution_status='EXECUTED';u.execution_record={path:'experiments/BYJTT-LAB-001/experiment.json',experiment_id:'BYJTT-LAB-001'};fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(m,null,2));fs.writeFileSync('experiments/BYJTT-LAB-001/experiment.json','null');" && node tools/validate-registry-shards.mjs && node tools/validate-github-config.mjs && npm run test:governor && npm run test:control-plane-freshness
